execute_misses.utterance: Я ошибся, это помидор, переключи культуру на томат

limitations: Authored synthetic Russian phrases; not recorded speech and not ASR output.
Exact phrases: Vosk grammar mode can only output grammar phrases, so paraphrases are not even transcribed.
Free phrases need Vosk without a grammar; its recognition errors are not included here.
FreeSpeech rules were written with every split of the corpus visible: no independent test.
